plan.planSummary: S05 adds set-based bulk participant writes and memory-bounded streaming exports over the existing S04 contacts/events/participants tables, plus one new export_jobs table for async exports. Logic concentrates in three new services (audience.py resolver, bulk_service.py for INSERT...ON CONFLICT/UPDATE/DELETE, export_service.py for db.stream-based CSV/XLSX) consumed by two new routers (bulk_participants.py at prefix=/participants and export.py at prefix=/export), with the async export processor added as a method on the existing QueueManager class. Two broken legacy analytics.py exports are deleted/rewritten, a require_viewer shim and an ExportJob model+migration are added, and the frontend gains a BulkParticipantPanel on EventDetailPage and an ExportMenu on ContactsPage/EventDetailPage.

featureTasks.name: S05-F05: bulk_service.py (set-based add/status/remove/preview + audit)
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: New backend/app/services/bulk_service.py, all async + type-hinted, ZERO per-row Python iteration. bulk_add_participants: validates event (404), resolves audience subquery + count, single dialect-branched INSERT...SELECT...ON CONFLICT(event_id,contact_id) DO NOTHING (pg_insert for postgresql else sqlite_insert, index_elements=['event_id','contact_id']), sets source/status/role/registered_by_id=caller_id/created_at via literals, commits, computes inserted from res.rowcount with the §4.5 fallback re-count when rowcount is -1 or out of range, skipped=requested-inserted, writes one audit row. bulk_update_status: single UPDATE WHERE event_id AND contact_id IN(subquery) [AND status==only_if_status], matched=updated=rowcount. bulk_remove: hard=False delegates to bulk_update_status(new_status='cancelled'); hard=True single DELETE. preview: counts only, no writes (participant count identical before/after). AC1-AC8,AC15 satisfied. Also export a public bulk_upsert_participants(session, rows) wrapper (master §5 reuse contract for S06) that performs the same ON CONFLICT upsert from a row list.
featureTasks.engineerNotes: CALLER ID: get_current_user returns dict with 'sub' (a str), NOT 'id' — the spec's caller_id=user['id'] is WRONG for this codebase. The router must pass caller_id=int(user['sub']) (events.py:173 uses int(user['sub'])). bulk_service signature takes caller_id:int. CONSTRAINT NAME: the actual constraint is uq_participant_event_contact (SINGULAR 'participant', models.py:316) NOT the spec's uq_participants_event_contact — but ON CONFLICT uses index_elements=['event_id','contact_id'] (columns) so it is name-independent; only reference the singular name if any code/test names the constraint. AUDIT: do NOT hand-roll AuditLog(...at=...) as spec §4.5 shows — the model field is created_at not 'at', and there is a canonical helper. Use `from app.services import audit as audit_svc; await audit_svc.record(db, actor_id=caller_id, action='participant.bulk_add', entity='participants', entity_id=req.event_id, before=None, after={...})` then commit (audit_svc.record at backend/app/services/audit.py:17 does NOT commit). Guard the audit call in try/except per AC15. DIALECT detection: use `db.bind.dialect.name` or `db.get_bind().dialect.name`; the spec's sync_session probing is fragile — prefer `db.bind.dialect.name` (AsyncSession exposes .bind). Participant model columns: contact_id, event_id, status, role, source, registered_by_id, created_at (models.py:285-313) — there is NO detection_id needed for bulk.

featureTasks.name: S05-F06: export_service.py (streaming CSV + constant-memory XLSX)

AC9,AC10,AC11 satisfied (33k rows memory-bounded; multiselect '; ' join; contact_reference renders names; BOM first chunk).
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Add `XlsxWriter>=3.2.0` to backend/requirements.txt (NOT currently present — verified). custom_field_def cols read row.custom_data.get(def.name) — Contact.custom_data is JSONB defaulting to {} (models.py:93); active defs are CustomFieldDef.is_active==True ordered by weight (models.py:523). contact_reference stored shape is JSON int or list[int] (CN-13) — resolve via a per-partition dict cache. For _build_participant_query date_from/date_to filter on events.occurrence_date OR events.start_at (both exist: models.py:154,159). Birth_date is a Date column (models.py:89). For SQLite tests, db.stream works but identity-map materialization is avoided by partitions(1000). Keep the 33k perf test marked so default CI stays fast.

plan.risks: 1. ACTOR-ID MISMATCH (highest): the spec's router/service code uses user['id'] and job.requested_by_id != user['id'], but get_current_user returns 'sub' (a str) with no 'id' key — copying the spec verbatim KeyErrors at runtime. Use int(user['sub']) everywhere (matches events.py:173). 2. CONSTRAINT NAME: actual name is uq_participant_event_contact (singular) vs spec's uq_participants_event_contact (plural). ON CONFLICT uses column index_elements so it works regardless, but any name-referencing code/test will fail if it copies the plural form. 3. AUDIT WRITE: spec hand-rolls AuditLog(...at=...) — wrong field name (created_at) and bypasses the canonical app/services/audit.py::record helper (master §5 reuse contract). Must use audit_svc.record + explicit commit, guarded. 4. WORKER SHAPE: queue_manager is a CLASS with self-methods and self.db_session_factory, not the module-level async functions the spec sketches — the export processor must be a bound method returning bool for the run()-loop `worked |=` pattern. 5. ROUTER PLACEMENT: there is NO participants.py router (S04 nested participant routes under /events/{id}/participants in events.py); the new bulk_participants.py with prefix='/participants' is correct and non-colliding — but main.py registration ordering must keep it inside the check_setup_complete-gated block and before the auth-exempt storage_router. 6. NAME SHADOWING: export.py /participants endpoints declare a query param `status: str|None` which shadows fastapi.status — import status as http_status or use integer codes to avoid AttributeError on status.HTTP_*. 7. S09 COUPLING: Group/SavedSearch models and criteria_compiler don't exist; audience.py must lazily import and degrade to a guarded 400 for group(smart)/saved_search, or it breaks module import for the all/ids paths that must work today. 8. DIALECT BRANCHING: ON CONFLICT, with_for_update(skip_locked), and JSONB must branch on db.bind.dialect.name; the spec's sync_session-probing for dialect is fragile — prefer db.bind.dialect.name (AsyncSession exposes .bind). 9. ROWCOUNT after ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is -1/unreliable on aiosqlite — the §4.5 fallback re-count is mandatory and must be tested (test_bulk_add_rowcount_fallback). 10. TEST DEPS: no is_postgres() helper exists in conftest (must be created) and psutil is absent (RSS assertion must be import-guarded or psutil added); the <1s/1500-row load test must be skipif(not is_postgres()). 11.
